scenes.name: R&B vs. pop
scenes.book: Loops 1 y 2. Una historia de la música electrónica
scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: Con The Neptunes o Timbaland, el R&B se convierte en la factoría de éxitos y la plantilla de cualquier aspirante a estrella adolescente.
scenes.family: Hip hop, breaks y ritmo lento

podcast.title: Full Composition of Taylor Swift's 1989
podcast.body: Max Martin entirely composed Taylor Swift's album `1989`, writing every song on it. "el 1989 de Taylor Swift, lo ha compuesto entero Max Martin entero todas las canciones."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Continued Hitmaking Prowess Post-2015
podcast.body: Max Martin has paradoxically composed all the hits since 2015, showcasing his enduring influence in the music industry. "Es un hombre pradigante compuso todos los éxitos desde el 2015 los ha compuesto todos."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Common Source of Teen Pop Hits
podcast.body: Max Martin was the consistent force behind many teen pop successes, having composed hits for the Backstreet Boys and later for Britney Spears and many other stars of the genre. "Max Martin, que es el hombre que había hecho los éxitos de los baques de pois entre otros... Britney Spears fue el tío que luego acabó componiendo todos los éxitos y todas estas estrellas del pop-up de la extente."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Dominance in Pop Songwriting
podcast.body: Max Martin produced virtually all successful pop songs, with nearly all of them attributed to his songwriting. "hizo todos los éxitos y casi pradían de todos los esms son suyos."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Enduring Dominance in Teen Pop
podcast.body: Max Martin remains an absolute protagonist in teen pop, a genre that has endured due to its ability to constantly renew itself since the generation that emerged with Britney Spears. "hoy el sigue siendo el protagonista absoluto del pop-up de la extente."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Extensive Discography with Major Pop Artists
podcast.body: Max Martin composed entire albums for Katy Perry, as well as for The Weeknd and Justin Timberlake. He also reportedly composed Taylor Swift's entire `Reputation` album. "también compuso todo el repito de diccion entero, también compuso entero discos enteros de Katy Perry, incluso de Del Wuyken y de Jacin Tinberlake."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Genius of Mainstream Pop
podcast.body: Max Martin is described as composing everything and being the "genius of mainstream pop." "Este tío lo compone todo, este tío es el genio del pop de gran consumo."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Greatest Hitmaker in History
podcast.body: Max Martin is described as possibly the greatest hitmaker in music history. "es el mayor fabricante de éxitos de la historia, posiblemente."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Key Producer for Britney Spears' Debut
podcast.body: Max Martin was a crucial figure behind Britney Spears' first album, `...Baby One More Time`, solidifying his role as one of the most important men in 21st-century music. "detrás del primer disco Britney Spears estaba uno de los hombres más importantes del siglo XXI en la música, que es Max Martin."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Media-Shy Producer
podcast.body: For all his chart success, Max Martin is notably camera and journalist shy, a trait he shares with Mut Lang, though Lang is described as even more reclusive. "Max Martin, who for all his chart success is notably camera and journalist Shy."

podcast.title: Most Number One Hits Record Holder
podcast.body: Max Martin, the Swedish pop craftsman, recently surpassed Sir George Martin as the producer with the most number one hits, accumulating 26 career Hot 100 toppers compared to Sir George's 23. "Max now has 26 career hot 100 toppers versus Sir George's 23."

podcast.title: Ongoing Influence as Producer
podcast.body: Max Martin continues to be a central figure, having composed entire albums for artists like Taylor Swift, including some of the most important records in mainstream pop. "Max Martin ha compuesto discos enteros de Taylor Swift, uno de los discos más importantes de todo este pop de gran consumo."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Primary Composer for Britney Spears' Debut Hits
podcast.body: Max Martin practically composed Britney Spears' entire `...Baby One More Time` album, writing all her successful songs from it after she went to Sweden. "se va a suecir a Britney Spears y Max Martin, con ponen prácticamente el disco de Baby One More Time. Todos los éxitos de Britney Spears los compuso Max Martin."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Producer for Diverse Pop Artists
podcast.body: Max Martin produced hits for a wide range of pop artists, including Westlife, Avril Lavigne, and Nick Carter. "Max Martin hizo los éxitos también de Westlife, de Abril Lavigne, de Nick Carter."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Prolific Producer for Boy Bands and Stars
podcast.body: The Swedish producer Max Martin wrote nearly entire albums for artists like the Backstreet Boys, composing all their hits, and also all the hits for *NSYNC and many other stars. "Max Martin, que suecó, había hecho casi los discos enterosos, los paquestritos entre otros. La VH escrito todos los éxitos de paquestritos, había hecho todos los éxitos de 5 de los en sync de un montón de estrellas."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Second Most Successful Hitmaker Ever
podcast.body: Max Martin is credited as the second greatest hitmaker in history, following only The Beatles. "está acreditado como el segundo mayor favoricante de éxitos de la historia después de los Beatles."

srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Signature "Maximalist Pop" Sound
podcast.body: Over more than a quarter-century, Max Martin has applied his "mathematically precise maximalist pop sound" to modern classics for artists like Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys, Kelly Clarkson, and The Weeknd. "Max has sprinkled his mathematically precise maximalist pop sound on modern classics from Britney and Backstreet Boys, Kelly Clarkson, and even The Weekend."
